svg.aria-label: Animated chart. 90 of the 364 held-out persons have no correct candidate. GLiNER2.5-Decide links about 19 of them to someone anyway (20.7%); kev-4b about 4 (4.1%). False-link rates for all eighteen models: Open-Jev-27B 3.7%; kev-27b 3.7%; kev-4b 4.1%; kev-9b 4.8%; JEV-9B 5.6%; Open-Jev-9B 5.6%; JEV-27B 5.6%; openjev-NLI-4B 6.7%; decider-35B-A3B 6.7%; GEV-26B 7.0%; decider-4b 8.1%; plumb-4b 8.9%; JevK5-9B 8.9%; decider-2b 13.0%; bekko-400m 13.3%; Laya 18.9%; von 18.9%; GLiNER2.5-Decide 20.7%.

g.text: 90 of the 364 test people have no correct candidate. For them, the right answer is ‘none’.
GLiNER2.5-Decide links about 19 of them to someone anyway.
kev-4b links about 4: one in twenty-five instead of one in five.
Across all eighteen, the large decoders are the cautious ones; the small encoders link too readily.
Each dot: one test person with no correct candidate.
Red: linked to a candidate anyway (mean of three seeds).
FALSE-LINK RATE · TUNED · MEAN OF 3 SEEDS
